name: AXIOM ASCENT SUMMIT — Annual Corponation Technology Expo
creator: Axiom Network One / HelixCorp Joint Venture
description: The largest corporate technology exposition in GLMZ, held annually in the Spire's Convention Towers and simultaneously broadcast as an immersive neural-feed experience available to Tier 3 subscribers and above. The Summit showcases next-generation BCI architectures, augmentation systems, geneware platforms, and smart-city infrastructure — all framed as aspirational lifestyle upgrades. Tier 4-5 attendees receive live demonstration implants and limited-edition augmentation previews as part of their admission package.
medium: physical attendance (Tier 4-5), neural feed broadcast (Tier 3+), holographic public display (all tiers)
cultural_impact: The Summit sets the public technological imagination of Meridian's middle and upper tiers, determining which augmentation aesthetics become mainstream and which corponation narratives about human-machine integration dominate public discourse.
controversy: Every year, the Axiom Ascent Summit is shadowed by a pirate counter-broadcast called 'The Real Summit' that hacks adjacent neural channels to show documented side effects, failed trials, and suppressed safety data for the technologies being celebrated.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 tech journalist attending the Summit on a press pass witnesses a demonstration malfunction that kills a test subject — and is immediately surrounded by corporate security before she can broadcast.

The pirate counter-broadcast 'The Real Summit' has been getting its data from someone inside the Axiom Ascent planning committee for three years; this year that person is ready to come forward completely.
A Shelf-born augmentation engineer whose stolen research forms the basis of this year's headline product arrives at the Summit with forged credentials and a plan.
